subject: SUPERTONIC_3_99M

official_code_repository.maintenance_notice: Official repository notice dated 2026-07-23 states the repository will be archived and there will be no further development or official support for the open-source Supertonic models; Voice Builder becomes unavailable after 2026-08-31.

source_observations: Official model documentation describes Supertonic 3 as approximately 99M parameters across public ONNX assets.
German (de) is one of 31 documented supported languages.
The documented inference path is local ONNX Runtime and does not require a GPU.
The official code repository exposes multiple local runtime examples including Python and C++.
The upstream maintenance discontinuation is a material lifecycle risk and must be carried into any F2 promotion decision.

trigger7_interpretation.hypothesis: A 99M ONNX model may provide a materially lower resident-memory/startup/CPU latency floor than larger expressive TTS candidates while retaining acceptable German intelligibility, making it useful as a resilient LOCAL-SOLO fallback even if it does not win the primary naturalness frontier.
trigger7_interpretation.counterhypothesis: Upstream discontinuation plus acoustic/prosodic quality or non-incremental synthesis limitations may make Supertonic 3 inferior even as a fallback once Piper/Thorsten, MagpieTTS and Qwen3-TTS are compared on the same target corpus and resource envelope.

next_exact_action: After the first terminal clay-direct-dev hardware receipt, benchmark pinned Supertonic 3 on the same German corpus against Piper/Thorsten, MagpieTTS v2602/v2607 and the claimed Qwen3-TTS family. Record TTFA, RTF, RSS, CPU, pronunciation, stable male voice suitability, prosody/expression, chunk continuity, cancellation and network-blocked behavior. Treat the discontinued upstream as frozen-source provenance, not as active-maintenance assurance.
